1.

This appeal is filed by the claimant/petitioner being dissatisfied with the quantum of compensation awarded vide judgment and award dated 01.09.2021 passed in MVC No.2501 of 2018 by the learned XII Additional District and Sessions Judge, Belagavi, sitting at Gokak.

entities.text: XII Additional District and Sessions Judge, Belagavi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Brief facts leading rise to the filing of this appeal are as follows:
3. On 19.11.2018, the petitioner was travelling in a NWKRTC bus bearing registration No.KA.23/F-722 from Shankeshwar towards Gokak.
When the bus was near Kotabagi on Hukkeri-Ghataprabha raod, to avoid the collision with the motorcycle which had come across the bus, the driver of the bus steered it off the road.
As a result, the bus fell into the ditch and the petitioner and the other inmates sustained grievous injuries.
Hence, the petitioner filed this claim petition under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act claiming compensation on account of the injuries sustained by him in a road traffic accident.
Accordingly, prays to allow the claim petition.
NC: 2026:KHC-D:3644 HC-KAR 4.
The respondent-NWKRTC filed statement of objections denying the averments made in the claim petition and hence prays to dismiss the claim petition.
5. The Tribunal based on the pleadings of the parties framed the relevant issues.
6. The petitioner to substantiate her case examined herself as PW.1, examined three witnesses as PW.2 to PW.4 and marked 73 documents as Exs.P.1 to P.73.
In rebuttal, the respondent-NWKRTC did not lead any evidence and no documents were produced.

7. The Tribunal, after assessing the verbal and documentary evidence, allowed the claim petition in part and awarded a compensation of 6,14,500/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till realisation of the amount excluding interest for the period commencing from March 2020 till 31.05.2021 owing to restricted functioning of the court due to COVID-19 pandemic.

8. The petitioner, being dissatisfied with the quantum of compensation awarded by the tribunal,
filed this appeal.

2 NC: 2026:KHC-D:3644 HC-KAR 9.
Heard the arguments of the learned counsel the petitioner and also learned counsel for the respondent.

10. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner examined the doctors as PW.2 and PW.4 who opined that the petitioner has suffered disability to the extent of 70% whereas the Tribunal has assessed the disability at 15% which is on a lower side.
He submitted that the accident is of 2018.
The Tribunal has taken the notional income at the rate of 9,000/- per month which is on a lower side.
Hence, on these grounds, he prays to allow the appeal.
11. Per contra, learned counsel for the respondent- NWKRTC submitted that the compensation awarded by the Tribunal is on the higher side.
Hence, prays to dismiss the appeal.

12. Perused the records and considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties.
13.
The point that would arise for consideration is regarding the quantum of compensation.
NC: 2026:KHC-D:3644 HC-KAR 14.
It is an undisputed fact that the petitioner was travelling in a NWKRTC bus and the accident occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the driver of the bus.
To prove that accident occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the driver of the bus, the petitioner has produced the charge sheet marked as Exhibit P.8.
The Tribunal was justified in recording the finding that the accident occurred due to rash and negligent driving of the driver of the bus.
Regarding quantum of compensation:
15. The petitioner was aged about 61 years as of the date of accident and it is contended that she was doing household and tailoring work, earning 20,000/- per month.
To substantiate her claim, the petitioner has not produced any document to show that she was earning 20,000/- per month.
In the absence of income proof, notional income has to be assessed as per the schedule issued by the KSLSA.
The accident is of 2018 and as per the schedule, national income of 11,750/- is taken.

The petitioner was aged about 61 years and the multiplier applicable to her age group is 7 as per the law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of Sarla Verma and ors. v. Delhi NC:
2026:KHC-D:3644 HC-KAR Transport Corporation and another1.

entities.text: Sarla Verma and ors. v. Delhi NC
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner examined two doctors as PW.2 and PW.4.
PW.2 has opined that the petitioner has suffered 40% disability in relation to her right eye and PW.4 has assessed the disability at 30% and accordingly issued disability certificate.
Combining the disability assessed by PW2 and PW4, the disability is to an extent of 70% whereas the tribunal has assessed the disability at 15% which is on the lower side.
This Court re-assess the disability at 25% to the whole body.

16. Considering the evidence of PW2 and PW4, this Court reassess the compensation as follows:

Enhanced compensation  is Rs.2,31,725/-
 17.
The petitioner has made out a ground for enhancement of compensation.

Hence, the petitioner is entitled to enhanced compensation of Rs.2,31,725/-.
18.
For the foregoing reasons, the point is answered accordingly.
19. In view of the above, the following ORDER (i) The appeal is allowed in part.
(ii) The judgment and award dated 01.09.2021 passed in MVC No.2501 of 2018 by the learned XII Additional District and Sessions Judge, Belagavi, sitting at Gokak, is hereby modified.

entities.text: XII Additional District and Sessions Judge, Belagavi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: (iii) The claimant/petitioner is entitled to an enhanced compensation of Rs.2,31,725/- in addition to the compensation awarded by the Tribunal.

NC: 2026:KHC-D:3644 HC-KAR (iv) The claimant/petitioner is entitled to total compensation of Rs.8,46,225/- with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of realisation.
(v) The respondent is directed to deposit the compensation amount within eight weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this judgment.
Draw award accordingly.
